hero.lead: A nation of 83.5 million whose Finance Agency plans about €512 billion of federal securities in 2026, as a €500 billion special fund for infrastructure and climate neutrality begins to invest.

capital.heading: A €500 billion fund to rebuild, and every child a reader.

record.text: Federal securities planned for 2026: about €318 billion in capital market auctions, €176 billion in money market paper and €16 to €19 billion in green securities
Special fund for infrastructure and climate neutrality: €300 billion for federal investment, €100 billion for the Länder and municipalities, €100 billion for the Climate and Transformation Fund
